Porcelain Veneers

A 1-minute patient guide with narration. Press space to pause, F for full screen.

Patient guide

Porcelain veneers.

Here is what to expect, start to finish.

What veneers fix.

Veneers are thin porcelain shells that cover the front of your teeth to fix stains, chips, gaps, and uneven edges.

Planning your smile.

A digital scan or impression captures your teeth so we can plan the shape, length, and shade of your new smile.

A gentle preparation.

A very thin layer of enamel is smoothed from the front of each tooth so the veneers sit naturally.

Custom-made shells.

Each veneer is crafted to match the shape and shade we planned together.

Bonded in place.

Each veneer is bonded to the front of your tooth and set with a gentle blue light.

Your new smile.

Porcelain looks natural and resists stains, so your smile stays bright.

Easy to care for.

Care for your veneers like your natural teeth.

Brush and floss dailyDon't bite hard objectsWear a night guard if you grind

Questions? Just ask.

Your dental team is happy to walk you through every step before, during, and after your visit.
